{{Top|notoc=1}}
'''Fascism''' was a political philosophy based on militant authoritarianism. A number of laws passed by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] were referred to as fascist by members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], opponents of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] were derogatorily referred to as fascists.<ref name="Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 2">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 2|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 2]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Fascism was a key inspiration for [[George Lucas]] in creating ''[[Star Wars]]''. In [[1973]], Lucas planned to focus on the protagonists defending their rightful home planet of [[Aquilae (The Star Wars)|Aquilae]], which he likened to [[Wikipedia:North Vietnam|North Vietnam]], and their conflict with gangsters aided by the Empire, which he likened to the [[Wikipedia:United States of America|United States of America]] ten years from 1973. The story would take place at the turning point of society pivoting toward either fascism or revolution.<ref name="The Making of Star Wars">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> Indeed, fascism and [[Wikipedia:Nazi Germany|Nazism]] was used as one of the inspirations for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the main antagonists of the [[original trilogy]]. Lucas also based the Rebels' [[Royal Award Ceremony/Legends|ending celebration scene]] in ''A New Hope'' on imagery from the 1935 Nazi propaganda film [[Wikipedia:Triumph of the Will|''Triumph of the Will'']].<ref name="The Magic of Myth">''[[Star Wars: The Magic of Myth]]''</ref>
